acceptanceCriteria: A documented reservation mechanism or pre-merge check prevents two open lanes from defining the same requirement ID.
Rerunning the batch C scenario (two lanes adding the next CAL-V0 ID) is refused or warned before batch integration.
body:
Filed 2026-10-08 by the orchestrator from batch C (branch claude/batch-c-2026-10-07, base 0c94c66c).

In batch C, three independent lanes each took the next free CAL-V0 ID: V1-0979 took 186, V1-0980 took 187, V1-0989 took 187 and V1-0915/0918 took 186/187. Each collision was found only at batch merge (requirement-definitions-check 'duplicate definition') and needed a renumber of spec rows, test names, code comments and build logs (CAL-V0-188, 189, 190). Expected: a lane can reserve IDs (for example on the ticket, or by a per-ticket suffix) or a check flags an ID already used on another open branch before review.
title: Parallel lanes collide on requirement IDs; reserve ranges or detect at branch time
